items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I know they had a little fellow down on the drum named Buck... But the guys was with him.

ctx.x: Piano. I'll tell you about him. James Hemingway. James Hemingway. And bass and all that. I really hadn't forgotten now, he was changing up so much. But I know they had a little fellow down on the drum named Buck. He was here a long time, stayed in New Orleans a good while. Bucket they called him. And Popeye on Alto. I can't call them guys names now that I wanted. But the guys was with him.
Did you ever hear Eva and Thomas and Bunk play together?
